focus_areas: Mechanical plausibility and segmentation of the waist buckle and strap connections.
Consistency of specular reflections across the curved metal surface.
Verification of surface smoothness to confirm absence of embossed ornaments.
Sharpness of the boundary between the polished metal and the textured background.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lower section of the armor where the breastplate meets the fauld (waist bands). AI models often struggle with mechanical connections like buckles, resulting in fused or nonsensical geometry. Also, scrutinize the reflections on the metal; they should logically correspond to the environment and the curvature of the plate, rather than appearing as random noise or smeared gradients. Explicitly verify that the surface is smooth and lacks any embossed patterns, as this was marked as absent.
image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) featuring anatomical contouring, a raised center ridge, and shoulder attachment points. The lower section includes a fauld (waist armor) with a central buckle mechanism. The background is a dark blue patterned fabric.
